story: Mount Nebo State Park is located near Dardanelle, Arkansas. Developed as a resort area in the late 19th century, it became a state park in 1928 with early development spearheaded by the Civilian Conservation Corps. It offers views of Lake Dardanelle, the Arkansas River, and surrounding mountain ridges.
matters: Rainwater percolating down through the soil builds up in underlying pockets on the mountain bench, resulting in numerous springs found on the Bench Trail.
